title: Provenance
description: Source-tracking metadata for an extracted finding (Variant or Biomarker). Required on every finding so a clinical-incident reviewer can answer: which tier of the parser produced this, on which page, at which bounding box, with which source text quote, and whether a downstream LLM judge agreed. A finding emitted to the canonical store without complete provenance is a clinical-safety failure and must be routed to human review per the engine 1 architecture.

sourceTier.description: Which extraction tier produced this finding. Aligns with the 5-tier escalation pipeline defined in unmiri-engine-1/docs/architecture.md. 'structured-feed' covers vendor XML/JSON/HL7-FHIR ingestion, 'human-curated' covers manual review queue overrides.

sourceFormat.description: Format of the source artifact this finding came from.

sourcePage.description: 1-indexed page number for PDF sources. Null for non-PDF sources.

sourceBbox.description: Bounding box of the source text region in PDF coordinate space. Null for non-PDF sources or when geometry was not preserved.

sourceTextQuote.description: Verbatim text quote from the source artifact that supports this finding. Required for any finding produced by the LLM tier (Tier 4) — the LLM is instructed to refuse output without a quote. Strongly recommended for all tiers; null only when the source format does not support text extraction (e.g., binary HL7 v2 fields).

sourceSection.description: Vendor-specific section heading the finding was extracted from (e.g., 'Genomic Findings', 'Therapies with clinical benefit', 'Variants of Unknown Significance'). Used for downstream tier classification (FMI section name → AMP/ASCO/CAP tier mapping).

extractorVersion.description: Identifier for the specific extractor that produced the finding (e.g., 'fmi_parser/0.2.0', 'tempus_parser/0.1.0', 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20'). Helps with regression analysis when a specific extractor version drifts.

judgeVerdict.description: Verdict from the LLM-as-judge gate (a second-model pass that reviews the candidate JSON against the page image). 'not-judged' when the finding bypassed the LLM tier (e.g., came from a structured feed). Disagreement → human review queue.

confidence.description: Per-finding confidence score from the extracting tier. Calibration is tier-specific: deterministic tiers use heuristic confidence (e.g., regex match strength + table-cell adjacency); LLM tiers use the model's own confidence signal where available, else 1.0 if the strict-JSON-Schema response validates. <0.85 typically routes to the next tier.

validationFlags.description: Validation gate flags raised during extraction. Empty array means all gates passed cleanly. Any flag → consumer SHOULD treat the finding with appropriate caution; downstream consumers MAY filter findings with specific flags.
